title: India and Italy seek closer trade and investment ties at Rome talks
summary:
India and Italy reaffirmed a €20 billion (~$22 billion) trade target for 2029 at the 23rd JCEC in Rome, led by Piyush Goyal and Antonio Tajani. 
Ministers reviewed trade, investment and industrial cooperation and welcomed concluded India-EU FTA talks to expand market access and strengthen supply chains. 
Goyal met Italian firms; a Rome forum drew around 80 Indian delegates and 12 startups.

title: UK factory output rises in quarter to Nov for 1st time since May 2024
summary:
UK manufacturing output rose in the three months to November, ending flat or falling volumes since mid-2024, the CBI’s Industrial Trends Survey showed. 
The weighted balance improved to +9 per cent from -10 per cent; manufacturers expect broadly flat output to February 2027. 
Total and export order books improved, but selling price expectations remained above historic norms.

title: US secures $17 bn in commercial deals during Trump's ASEAN visit
summary:
US President Donald Trump’s visit to the Philippines and attendance at the ASEAN Summit secured more than $17 billion in commercial deals and strategic investments for US companies. 
He also announced the substantial conclusion of a US-Thailand trade deal that will eliminate tariffs on 99 per cent of goods and expand market access for American exports.

title: North India’s cotton yarn trade slows as cotton prices fall
summary:
North India's cotton yarn markets turned sluggish as fibre prices fell, with Ludhiana yarn down ₹2 (~$0.02) per kg and Delhi stable amid weak demand.
Panipat recycled yarn remained steady but slow after weak festive home textiles buying; traders now expect colder weather to lift winter clothing.
Cotton eased ₹20–40 per maund after ICE futures fell, pressuring Indian cotton and yarn exporters.

title: 14% crossbred drop: Can Fine Merino lead Australia's wool market?
summary:
Australia’s Week 20 wool auctions recovered in local terms, with AWEX’s EMI up 24 cents to 1,722 A¢/kg (~$11.56/kg) clean; its US-dollar equivalent fell to 1,184 US¢/kg.
Fine and medium Merino guides rose 2.3–3.5 per cent, but 26- to 30-micron crossbreds fell 1–3 per cent in US-dollar terms.
The EMI is down 9.6 per cent since July despite tighter supply; recovery depends on stronger processor demand.

title: Europe's financial stability outlook clouded by AI & trade risks: ECB
summary:
The European Central Bank has warned that stretched AI valuations, fiscal imbalances and geopolitical tensions are increasing financial stability risks, with potential market repricing threatening banks and non-bank financial institutions. 
While the euro area economy has remained resilient, energy market pressures, trade uncertainty and AI-driven cyber threats are adding to vulnerabilities.

title: Egypt grows 16.2%, Türkiye slips: Is apparel manufacturing shifting?
summary:
Egypt's garment exports are rising as Türkiye faces cost pressure, but evidence does not prove a mass exit of Turkish manufacturers.
TexPro puts Egypt's HS 61-62 exports up 13.6 per cent to $1.757 billion in H1 2026; Türkiye fell 1.9 per cent to $7.785 billion.
Egypt expects $2 billion in foreign investment in 2026, while Turkish fabric inputs and labour-standard risks remain key tests.

title: Jordan garment exports diversify. Why does America still take 77%?
summary:
Jordan's garment exports rose 3.4 per cent to JD1.236 billion (~$1.74 billion) in January-August 2026, but the US still took 77.4 per cent as sales there slipped.
Non-US markets delivered all net growth, rising 20.8 per cent, led by Canada, the Netherlands and Germany.
The shift is limited by a 95 per cent knitwear mix, import-led fabrics and tougher European order, costing and compliance demands.

title: Smartex.ai unveils AI fabric ecosystem with Tony Fadell as chairman
summary:
Smartex.ai has appointed Tony Fadell as chairman ahead of its product ecosystem’s debut at SmartCollab Hong Kong on 27 November.
Combining Inspect hardware with IQ software, the system uses AI to track fabric quality and share data across mills, factories and brands.
With over 800 systems installed in 10 countries, Smartex aims to identify defects earlier, reduce waste and improve sourcing decisions.

title: China, South Korea substantially conclude upgraded FTA talks
summary:
China and South Korea have substantially concluded the second phase of negotiations on their free trade agreement, China’s Ministry of Commerce said.
The talks upgraded chapters on investment, trade in services, financial services and economic cooperation, plus related annexes.
Bilateral trade reached $440.9 billion in the first ten months of 2026, up 63.7 per cent year on year.

title: Egypt gains 29.1% in EU apparel: Can it challenge Turkiye by 2027?
summary:
EURATEX and Egyptian export bodies signed a Cairo pact on EU circularity, digital product passports, greener production, customs and training.
EU clothing imports from Egypt reached €689 million in 2025, up 17.2 per cent year on year and 48 per cent from 2022; January–June 2026 imports were put at $747 million, up 29.1 per cent.
Egypt targets garment exports of about $12 billion by 2030.

title: Bangladesh basics account for 97% of apparel export growth in July-Oct
summary:
Basic garments generated about 97 per cent of Bangladesh’s apparel export growth in July-October of fiscal 2026-27, EPB data showed.
Total apparel exports rose 5.82 per cent to $13.75 billion from $12.99 billion a year earlier.
High-value products grew just 0.67 per cent to $1.86 billion, cutting their share to 13.54 per cent.

title: Hong Kong's apparel imports fall 4.4%, China's share declines
summary:
Hong Kong’s apparel imports fell 4.4 per cent to $4.475 billion in January–September 2026, while China’s share dropped to 41 per cent from 45 per cent.
China remained the top supplier, but shipments declined 13 per cent to $1.833 billion.
Italy, Vietnam, France and Japan increased shipments, signalling broader sourcing diversification in 2026.

title: India’s apparel exports to US fall 20.5%: Can it win back buyers?
summary:
India’s readymade garment exports rose 20.33 per cent year on year to $1.287 billion in October 2026, but April-October exports remained 2.97 per cent lower and US-bound shipments fell sharply.
The rebound follows a weak October 2025 base, with the latest value only 4.8 per cent above October 2024.
No India-specific US tariff advantage is confirmed without an implemented apparel schedule.

title: US' Amer Sports raises 2026 outlook as Q3 revenue climbs 24%
summary:
Amer Sports raised its FY26 revenue growth outlook to 25-26 per cent after third-quarter revenue increased 24 per cent to $2.17 billion. 
Net income attributable to equity holders rose 67 per cent to $240 million, while adjusted operating margin improved to 16.4 per cent. 
Technical Apparel and Outdoor Performance posted revenue growth of 26 per cent and 27 per cent, respectively.

title: China takes 34.29% of EU27 extra-EU apparel imports: Can it hold?
summary:
EU27 extra-EU apparel imports fell 2.46 per cent to €70.72 billion (~$77.7 billion) in January-September 2026, while China’s share rose to 34.29 per cent.
China’s import value grew 4.46 per cent to €24.25 billion and Vietnam’s rose 4.33 per cent to €3.47 billion.
Bangladesh fell 11.91 per cent to €13.48 billion, with share down to 19.06 per cent from 21.10 per cent.

title: Could Bangladesh’s ongoing labour protest impact sourcing dynamics?
summary:
Bangladesh garment protests have shut around 65 factories in Savar, Ashulia and Gazipur as workers seek a minimum wage rise to Taka 32,000 (~$256).
Another 56 reportedly declared holidays, deepening disruption after an energy crisis in a sector employing over four million and earning 80 per cent of merchandise exports.
Sustained delays could divert orders to India and hit Indian yarn suppliers.

title: US' Nike previews future innovations across sports and lifestyle
summary:
Nike, Inc. unveiled Tuned Air, Nike Free and an expanded Nike Mind range at its World of Athletes showcase in Beaverton, Oregon, alongside new footwear and apparel innovations for running, football, training, basketball and outdoor sport.
The company also previewed Nike Sportswear concepts including Therma-FIT A.I.R., Project Ride and Nike Morpho X.

title: Jordan's apparel exports rise 3.2% to $1.69 bn in Jan–Aug 2026
summary:
Jordan’s apparel exports rose 3.2 per cent year on year to JOD 1.196 billion (~$1.69 billion) in January–August 2026, led by knitted clothing.
Knitted apparel exports increased 4.6 per cent to JOD 1.177 billion and made up 98.3 per cent of clothing exports; woven exports fell 41.3 per cent.
August clothing exports rose 5.3 per cent, while apparel imports grew 2.8 per cent in the eight months.

title: US' Nike to launch Tuned Air running footwear in late 2027
summary:
Nike has unveiled Tuned Air, a proprietary digital-print and selective-lamination platform designed to give athletes tailored cushioning, comfort, durability and responsiveness across sports.
The technology has cut average new Air-unit development time by 70 per cent at Nike’s Advanced Product Creation Center, with runner availability planned for late 2027 before a broader rollout.
